title: NO MORE BLACKPILLS, MR. DOOMER: Reject Nihilism
summary: A long philosophical essay built on Nietzsche quotes that diagnoses the 'doomer' mindset as a dishonest coping mechanism: passive pessimism disguised as wisdom, a false sense of superiority, social rejection reframed as intelligence, and a refusal of responsibility. NH ranks active pessimists highest, urges doomers to rebuild through others and take ownership, and ties accepting your current inferiority to progress in bodybuilding.
claims: The black pill is a bleak truth about the world; the problem is doomers choke on it instead of digesting it and turning it into a weapon
Knowledge that makes you a worse version of yourself was poison all along
Doomers use the black pill as an excuse to give up and to justify misery they inflict on themselves
A true pessimist has a realistic view of the world; what he does with it separates active from passive pessimists
Doomers still chase pleasure, so they are hedonistic materialists, not true world-renouncers
People who constantly declare self-hatred do it to get consoled; they replaced confidence with self-pity
Announcing you are a doomer is a secret plea to be talked out of it, which shows you are not truly convinced
Feeling superior through knowledge you never act on is fake; only action and accomplishment count
Blaming social isolation on high intelligence is a cope; it reflects lacking social and emotional intelligence
Information can be poison as much as remedy, and constant information is making people miserable
Ranking of mindsets: active pessimist best, then active optimist, then passive optimist, with passive pessimist the worst
In Berserk, Guts is the active pessimist, Casca the passive pessimist, Griffith the active optimist
Believing you have no free will is the cowardly choice; believing in total free will is naive but brave and better
If you are not the captain of your own life, someone else is
The only way to improve your life is action
NH was an awkward, bullied kid with a tough puberty; the wound healed and made him stronger
For doomers, the fix is to rebuild with the energy of others first, not to recenter on themselves, unlike NH's usual advice to build yourself up before alliances
From teaching autistic kids, NH saw that one bad social encounter can make a child preemptively hostile, which perpetuates the isolation
Seek out people who love themselves rather than echo chambers that confirm your bias
An ideology that cannot survive contradiction is a delusion
Disliking someone you can't match and inventing flaws for them is a cope; instead admit you want what they have and work for it
Defense mechanisms built around a trauma often become worse than the trauma itself
Accepting your inferiority is the first step to becoming superior; to be good at bodybuilding you must first suck at it
NH spent five or six years looking like a skeleton with no muscle before building his physique
Spiritual death usually precedes suicide; preventing it can prevent physical death
Every limit, including a so-called natural limit, exists to be broken
Take advice only from people making something of their lives, not from those who have given up
Suffering is not evil; a true man says life is suffering with a smile
